title: Late Sena Transition Before the 1204 Conquest
subtitle: Lakshmanasena's final phase and the eve of political rupture.
summary: The late Sena phase under Lakshmanasena (c. 1178-c. 1205) represents the final major pre-1204 court-centered order in Bengal, ending with his expulsion from Nadia by Bakhtiyar Khalji.
heroTagline: The final Sena chapter provides the immediate context for Bengal's 1204-1205 power transition.
whyItMatters: This event matters because it is the direct bridge between pre-conquest political culture and the restructured order that followed the Nadia capture.
